name: Canary Data
description: Generate new investment ideas and perform in-depth analysis of any publicly traded business using proprietary Canary datasets, intelligence and synthesis within Claude. Canary plays well with other financial MCPs to combine to make Claude into a world-class investment analyst.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Canary Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Canary Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.canary-data.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Canary Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canary Data provides these MCP tools: new_accounting_issue.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Canary Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Canary Data in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Canary Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canary Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Canary Data is developed by Canary Data. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
